question: Will Stevanović Dušan (HNK Gorica) receive a yellow card in HNK Gorica vs Slaven Belupo on Nov 7, 2026 (kick-off 14:00 UTC), regular time + stoppage time only?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if Stevanović Dušan, playing for HNK Gorica, receives at least one yellow card during the HNK Gorica vs Slaven Belupo match (kick-off 2026-11-07T14:00:00Z) strictly after 2026-11-05T21:45:43.603Z and at or before 2026-11-07T23:00:00.000Z, counting only events occurring in regular time and stoppage time (i.e., excluding extra time and penalty shoot-outs).
- "No": Wins if Stevanović Dušan does not receive any yellow card during the same match within the same period and the same time restrictions, or if he does not appear in the match at all.

Clarifications:
- Yellow card eligibility is limited strictly to in-match events in the 90-minute regulation period plus any added stoppage time at the end of each half; cards shown after the final whistle of regulation time, or during extra time or penalties, do not count.
- If the match is postponed, cancelled, or not completed before 2026-11-07T23:00:00.000Z, "No" wins.
